title: Master CSS 'line-height' for Optimal Readability & UI Harmony
tweet: Unlock superior UI readability! Dive into CSS 'line-height' and see how perfectly tuned vertical spacing transforms user experience with web fonts. A critical skill for every web designer. #CSSTypography #UIDesign #WebFonts
tip: For optimal body text readability, aim for a unitless 'line-height' value between 1.4 and 1.6 times the 'font-size'. This provides sufficient vertical breathing room, especially with longer line lengths, making text easier to follow and improving overall UI harmony.
